summary: Actual user-supplied Client Area form controls, sanitized before persistence and parsed offline with the capture tool. An independent anonymous product-runtime probe confirmed the billing origin, /clientarea/ path, visible POST form controls and no login iframe. Only structural attributes are retained; account text, password, hidden action and security-token values, scripts and the form action query are absent. This records account/password controls, not authenticated acceptance or automatic authenticator sign-in; the second-stage contract is still unavailable.

sources.title: User-supplied actual login-widget form fragment, with all values and page tokens removed before offline capture
sources.note: This is the supplied form fragment, not a whole-page render or an authenticated acceptance run. Form method is POST; the original action is a same-document redirect query, withheld by the sanitizer. Input values and hidden values were never persisted.

fixtures.note: Synthetic token-free structural fixture at the vendor publicly observed Client Area destination; no page scripts or field values.

staysInteractive.note: User selected authenticator-app MFA, but its actual sign-in route, input, submit, method/action and frame metadata are still pending. No challenge selectors have been inferred.
Email MFA is a separate verification method and cannot use the saved authenticator seed.
Recovery, MFA enrollment and any unsupported layout.
